title: thelypteris flavovirens
intro: Thelypteris flavovirens, commonly known as the golden evergreen fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris flavovirens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. However, limited research is available on this plant, and more studies are needed to confirm its full range of health benefits and therapeutic actions.
